answer: Tie each agent identity to a stake that decays over a long horizon: a new agent must lock collateral and earn reputation only through verified work, so a fresh identity starts hollow, with no trust and no rewards. Reputation accrues slowly, like nectar gathered drop by drop, while a sybil farm must fund every copy's stake and wait out the same delay, so spinning up thousands of fake agents costs real capital and time, and any detected fraud burns the stake.
